body.title: Wire readOnlySessionOnce's vibe branch to await the dispatched turn
body.summary: In src/agent/providers/cli-provider.ts's readOnlySessionOnce, replace the vibe branch's current 'unreachable' throw with: call startTurn with mode:'read-only', await its result with the absolute deadline already computed at call entry, and parse the result against the caller's schema.
acceptanceChecks: readOnlySessionOnce's vibe branch returns the schema-validated answer on a qualified capability, end to end
readOnlySessionOnce's vibe branch surfaces VibeReadOnlyUnavailableError (with its reason) when the capability is unavailable, rather than throwing 'unreachable'
The absolute deadline computed once at call entry is honored even while waiting on a shared/in-flight qualification

tests.name: readOnlySessionOnce's vibe branch returning the schema-validated answer on a qualified capability
the recorded argv matching buildArgv's own values exactly except outputDir
the VibeReadOnlyUnavailableError path when probes exhaust the retry bound or export.json is unusable
the capabilityPolicy precondition refused before readOnlySessionOnce is reached
